name: orbit-radar
title: Orbit Radar
description: A radar dish rises from the edge: a beam sweeps round and a small craft climbs the rim as minutes count.

perf.budget: The beam and craft are still canvases and views turned on the UI thread, so the beam animates at rest without redrawing.

a11y.reducedMotion: The beam holds still, the craft jumps to its place and the minutes do not count.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { OrbitRadar } from '@/components/kinetik/orbit-radar';

<OrbitRadar name="LUNA-2" minutes={23} progress={0.58} />;
```

## When to use

- Anything approaching with a known arrival: a satellite pass, a delivery drone, a ferry.
- A hero widget where a bit of mission control suits the product.

## When not to use

- Real positions: the dish is a picture of progress, not a map.

## Notes

- `progress` is yours to compute. At 1 the craft reaches the top of the arc.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add orbit-radar`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
